origin.description: Coefficient of variation of a numeric vector, or the square of that coefficient.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Numeric vector. The measures are defined for non-negative values.

arguments.name: square
arguments.text: If true, return the squared coefficient of variation.

arguments.name: na.rm
arguments.text: If true, drop missing values first. If false, any missing value makes the result missing.

origin.details: sqrt((n - 1) * var(x) / n) / mean(x), where var is the sample variance. That ratio is the population standard deviation over the mean. square=TRUE squares it. ineq type "var" and "square.var" call this function.
origin.value: A single number, the coefficient of variation or its square.

translation.description: Coefficient of variation of a numeric vector, or the square of that coefficient.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Numeric vector. The measures are defined for non-negative values. Missing values are NaN.

arguments.name: square
arguments.text: If true, return the squared coefficient of variation.

arguments.name: na_rm
arguments.text: If true, drop missing values first. If false, any missing value makes the result NaN.

translation.details: sqrt((n - 1) * sample_variance(x) / n) / mean(x). That ratio is the population standard deviation over the mean. square=True squares it. ineq type "var" and "square.var" call var_coeff.
translation.value: A single number, the coefficient of variation or its square.
translation.example:
from ineq.measures import var_coeff

# generate vector (of incomes)
x = [541, 1463, 2445, 3438, 4437, 5401, 6392, 8304, 11904, 22261]
print(var_coeff(x))
print(var_coeff(x, square=True))
